title: Pan-Seared Trout with Crispy Toastie
description: A Thai-inspired dish featuring pan-seared trout served with a crispy toastie and a side of fresh herbs.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Dust the trout fillets with flour, shaking off excess.
Dip the floured trout in beaten eggs and then coat with panko breadcrumbs.
Heat butter in a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the coated trout fillets and sear for 3-4 minutes on each side.
Remove the trout from the skillet and set aside.
Butter one side of the brioche bread slices.
Place one slice, butter side down, in a skillet over medium heat.
Top with a slice of cheese (if using) and another slice of brioche, butter side up.
Cook until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Serve the pan-seared trout with crispy toastie and garnish with toasted coconut flakes and fresh herbs.
